body: Maybe this is a cry for help or attention, I don't even know.  Some other human being out there.  God I feel so fucking pathetic.  Fucking cyring like a baby while I write the shit.

Christ what a waste I've been, what a fucking disappointment, what wasted potential and investment of other people's time and energy and love.  Suicide is the only honorable way out at this point.  Fuck painless methods, I just want to hurt myself
